from __future__ import annotations

import typing

import pytest

import llm_router

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")

_BLOCK_SECONDS = 3.0
_ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT = 0.05
_BOUNDED_TIME = 1.0


class _BlockingExecutor:
    """Executor double whose first call blocks until the gate is set."""

    def __init__(self, gate: typing.Any) -> None:
        self.gate = gate
        self.calls = 0

    def execute(self, request: object) -> object:
        assert request is not None
        self.calls += 1
        if self.calls == 1:
            self.gate.wait(_BLOCK_SECONDS)
        return "ok"


@pytest.mark.verifies("REQ_ROUTE_TIMEOUT_FALLBACK[revision==1]")
def test_sync_timeout_does_not_wait_for_blocked_route() -> None:
    """A timed-out attempt must not block the caller on the stuck route."""
    time_mod = typing.sys.modules["time"]
    gate = typing.sys.modules["threading"].Event()
    executor = _BlockingExecutor(gate)
    router = llm_router.LLMRouter(
        ["openai/model-a"],
        executor=executor,
        attempt_timeout_seconds=_ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT,
        max_attempts=1,
    )
    started = time_mod.monotonic()
    with pytest.raises(TimeoutError, match=r"timed out"):
        router.query("hello")
    elapsed = time_mod.monotonic() - started
    gate.set()
    assert elapsed < _BOUNDED_TIME
